newsitem.title: KENYA: Rates stable at Kenya treasury bills auction.
newsitem.headline: Rates stable at Kenya treasury bills auction.

text.p: Rates remained stable at Kenya's treasury bill auctions, the central bank reported on Friday.

The bank said it offered an average interest rate of 14.886 percent on its 28-day bills from 14.85 in the previous week and a 21.850 percent interest on its 91-day bills from 21.90 percent previously.
There were no bids for the 182-day treasury bills.
The government offered 4.0 billion shillings in treasury bills at the Thursday auction out of which 3.041 billion shillings was tendered and 3.034 billion shillings accepted.
A total of 238 bids were made. Some 154 were successful. Four bids were not successful while 80 were not competitive.
The central bank normally does not say what percentage of the bills was tendered by foreign or domestic investors.
